name: Vehicle Motion Cues
tagline: 在 iOS 15–17 的屏幕边缘显示车辆加速、减速与转向提示。
description: 车辆运动提示会在屏幕边缘显示动态圆点，让乘客更直观看到车辆加速、减速和转向的方向变化。
支持自动、开启和关闭模式、灵敏度调节、控制中心快捷开关，以及无需乘车即可检查动画方向的模拟场景。
notice: ⚠️ 仅供乘客使用，驾驶时请勿操作设备。模拟运动只用于检查动画与方向，不代表真实乘车效果。
features: 屏幕边缘圆点响应加速、减速与转向
自动、开启和关闭三种运行模式
可调节圆点响应灵敏度
提供控制中心快捷开关
内置自动演示、左右转、加速、刹车和 S 弯模拟场景
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的车辆运动提示。
选择自动、开启或关闭模式，并按需要调整灵敏度。
可将车辆运动提示模块添加到控制中心以快速开关。
需要原地检查动画时，选择测试场景并开启模拟运动；测试完成后请关闭模拟运动。

changes: 新增随车辆加速、减速与转向变化的屏幕边缘运动提示。
新增自动模式、灵敏度调节、控制中心开关与多种模拟测试场景。
修复设置修改未即时生效及控制中心模块不可用的问题，并增强三语显示。

en.name: Vehicle Motion Cues
en.tagline: Show acceleration, braking, and turning cues at the screen edges on iOS 15–17.
description: Vehicle Motion Cues displays animated dots along the screen edges so passengers can see directional changes during acceleration, braking, and turns.
It provides Automatic, On, and Off modes, sensitivity adjustment, a Control Center toggle, and simulated scenarios for checking animation direction without a moving vehicle.
en.notice: ⚠️ For passenger use only. Do not operate the device while driving. Simulated motion only checks animation and direction; it does not represent real-world effectiveness.
features: Edge dots respond to acceleration, braking, and turns
Automatic, On, and Off operating modes
Control Center toggle for quick access
Automatic demo, left turn, right turn, acceleration, braking, and S-curve simulations
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open Vehicle Motion Cues in Settings after installation.
Choose Automatic, On, or Off and adjust sensitivity as needed.
Add the Vehicle Motion Cues module to Control Center for quick toggling.
To check animation while stationary, choose a test scenario and enable Simulated Motion; turn simulation off when finished.

changes: Added screen-edge motion cues that respond to vehicle acceleration, braking, and turns.
Added Automatic mode, sensitivity adjustment, a Control Center toggle, and multiple simulated test scenarios.
Fixed Settings changes not applying immediately and the Control Center module being unavailable, and improved trilingual presentation.
